stage_gate: All fixed LongMemEval arms finalized, all complete arms authenticated, and the prespecified observed-top-two combination resolved (complete, retained failure, alias, or unavailable). No MAB benchmark inference before this gate.
conditional_addition: If the LongMemEval-selected combination has a genuinely new config, append that single exploratory config in a separate child MAB registration before any MAB inference. Otherwise retain the original matrix and record its alias/unavailable status. Never select from MAB outcomes.
later_tasks: BEAM and MemoryArena are not launched until earlier stages have completed and their own exact registrations and gates are ready.
